# 策略對照表 · 策略对照表 · Policy table

<!-- Generated by tools\New-PolicyTable.ps1. Do not edit by hand. -->

Generated 2026-10-21 from Windows 10.0.26300.0, reading the policy file for `IE`.
Another Windows build may ship different states, and Microsoft adds policies over time.

**Class** is the classification in `src/EULord/Core/Catalog.cs`, and it decides what the superset does:

| Class | 中文 | What the superset does |
|---|---|---|
| Gain | 好處 / 好处 | Takes the EU state. |
| Loss | 損失 / 损失 | **Refuses** the EU state and keeps Windows' own. |
| Taste | 見仁見智 / 见仁见智 | Keeps Windows' own state unless you tick it. |

**Description** says what the policy does when it is *enabled*, not what we set it to.
**Global** and **EU** are the states Windows itself would use outside and inside the EEA.
**Result** is what this tool writes with nothing ticked.
